name: SkillWorks
measures: Every Claude Code skill, subagent, plugin and marketplace repository.
method: Each listing's files are read from source and scored 0–100 on four weighted components. A listing that does not parse into something Claude Code could load is counted as broken, not quietly dropped from the denominator.

name: StillShipping
measures: Whether an agent tool is still being worked on.
method: Commit, release and issue activity pulled from the GitHub API nightly and turned into one of three verdicts. The verdict is recomputed every night rather than recorded once, so a project that goes quiet changes its own row without anybody editing it.

name: ToolDrift
measures: What the AI coding tools changed overnight — pricing, models, rankings.
method: Vendor changelogs, pricing pages and store rankings are fetched on a schedule and diffed against the previous capture. A price is recorded from the page that states it, and a page that has moved is followed and the redirect published rather than silently followed.

name: KitGrade
measures: SaaS starter kits, graded on what is actually in the box.
method: Kits are graded from measured facts rather than from their own landing pages, and the hands-on count is published separately from the documented count — a kit somebody installed and ran is a different claim from a kit somebody read about.

name: StoreReady
measures: Which AI app builders produce something the App Store will actually accept.
method: Every verdict is attached to numbered evidence — a policy clause, a rejection thread, a shipped binary. A builder nobody has evidence for is published as unknown rather than given the benefit of the doubt.

name: BlockDex
measures: Every component, block and theme inside every public shadcn registry.
method: Each registry is crawled and its items are read individually, so an item that disappears between crawls is counted as removed rather than forgotten. Removals over the last thirty days are published beside the total.

name: RuleStack
measures: How teams actually write agent config — AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the rest.
method: Config files are read out of public repositories and measured: length, whether they carry runnable commands, whether they carry code. The format shares are computed from the files found, not from a survey of what people say they use.

name: CiteRank
measures: Whether answer engines cite a site when a buyer asks about its category.
method: A question is put to a live answer engine through a real browser and the answer it returns is recorded — one row per question per engine per run. Nothing is inferred from search rank; a citation counts when the engine actually produced it.

name: doc-extract-bench
measures: Document-extraction APIs, scored on pinned public datasets.
method: Every vendor is run against the same pinned subsets and EVERY RAW RESPONSE IS COMMITTED, so the published accuracy can be recomputed offline by anyone with no API keys and no account. It is the only one of the nine whose numbers a stranger can fully re-derive.
